speaker: Sheldon
text: Good morning, Leonard. Yeah, we're gonna have to stop by Pottery Barn on the way to work. I bought these Star Wars sheets, but they turned out to be much too stimulating to be compatible with a good night's sleep.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't like the way Darth Vader stares at me.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh-huh. I'm not going to work.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Just because your career's been stagnant for a few years has no reason to give up.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, I was up all night using the new free electron laser for my X-ray diffraction experiment.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Did the laser accidentally burn out your retinas? Then you can drive.

speaker: Leonard
text: No.

speaker: Leonard
text: Didn't I tell you I'd be working nights and that you'd have to make other arrangements? I did.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You did? I didn't. Let's go.

speaker: Leonard
text: Good night, Sheldon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But how am I going to get to work? I can't take the bus anymore. They don't have seatbelts. And they won't let you lash yourself to the seat with bungee cords.

speaker: Leonard
text: Take the bus.

speaker: Leonard
text: You tried to lash yourself to the seat with bungee cords?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I didn't try. I succeeded. For some reason, it alarmed the other passengers, and I was asked to de-bus.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, you're a big boy. You'll figure it out.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Don't talk to me like I'm a child. I'm taking you to return my Star Wars sheets. Benny? Benny? Benny? Leonard's asleep.

speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon, what is it? Thanks for the update.

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, wait. You have to drive me to work.

speaker: Penny
text: I, I really don't think I do.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But I don't drive, and I can't take the bus.

speaker: Penny
text: Hey, hey, you'll be fine as long as you don't do that bungee cord thing, okay?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Don't, Penny. Didn't you recently state that you and I are friends?

speaker: Penny
text: Yes, Sheldon, we are friends.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Then I hereby invoke what I'm given to understand as an integral part of the implied covenant of friendship.
